name: PageHeader
title: Templates/Platform/Page/PageHeader
summary: The heading that opens a page: an h1 whose `data-size` picks the heading token by page level, a one-line description, and the actions the page owns on the right, the Documentation link first and the create action on the outer edge, both outlined `Button`s at the medium size. First-level lists render it at the medium size; detail tabs and settings sub-pages such as a resource’s Settings tab render it small; a creation hub’s headline is the only large one. Built from `Button`. When the row runs out of room, the actions move below the copy together instead of squeezing the description; on a phone they stack, each at full width.

variants.name: SettingsPage
variants.summary: A settings sub-page heading: small title and description, no actions.
